q1_issues.issue: 'by this method' names the means of the separating, not of the believing (a method cannot be the passive by-phrase agent of 'believed'), so the Instrument atom is misattached to sk_believe_1 and asserted at top level instead of sitting inside the sealed complement on sk_separate_1.

'separated from' leaves true philosophy distinguished rather than altered, and the role test is at best unclear here, so the instruction set's 'when the test is unclear, default to Theme' rule makes the sealed (Patient sk_separate_1 true_philosophy) the wrong role.

q2_gaps: adjective modifier on a bare kind-denoting mass NP ('true philosophy', 'popular wisdom'): the non-fusing alternative the compound section contrasts against ('a dented pail' -> two Member atoms) is defined only for an individual witness, so a bare kind constant has no stated non-fusing encoding and the 'never fuse incidental description' line has nothing to fall back to
notes: The non-factive seal is handled correctly - the complement is only a Theme term, nothing about the separating is asserted at top level, and the definite 'this method' projects its typing atom. The impersonal passive attitude ('it was believed that P') leaves the attitude with no Experiencer, which the agentless-passive rule licenses even though the attitude template assumes a holder.
